items.html: The first interpretation is this: that all the aspects of the ten Sefirot of Katnut are divided into three, namely: pregnancy (Ibur), nursing (Yenika), and Mochin. These are the three lower ones of Elokim, the three middle ones, and the three upper ones. And all this is called externality. And afterward, in all the aspects of Gadlut there are pregnancy, nursing, and Mochin, which are: the three lower ones of Havayot, the three middle ones, and the three upper ones. And all this is called internality.
